{{Top|leg}}
'''Hustru fönster''' was a [[Vulanish]] phrase that found its way into the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] language. It was literally translated into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] as "the wife in the window."

The [[Ensterite]] were disciples of a fanatical Corellian social system which forbade marriage with anyone from outside the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], or, in the most extreme cases, anyone from outside [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Among certain ensters, the phrase ''hustru fönster'' would take on a new meaning. An enster with sufficient means would marry a fellow enster, but the "wife" or "husband" was in reality a person who entered the marriage for reasons of commerce or position only. The person's real lover was "hired" as a gardener, maid or cook, so that she or he could be with their true love.

==Behind the scenes==
"Hustru" is [[Wikipedia: Swedish|Swedish]] for "wife", whereas "fönster" means "window" in the same language.<ref>Online Swedish to English Dictionary[http://dictionaries.travlang.com/SwedishEnglish/]</ref>
